units.source_text: 但是，对大竹七段来说，这大概早在五天前就看准了。

en.t: But for Otake 7-dan, he had probably seen this clearly as early as five days before.

units.source_text: 今早续弈时，他按捺住焦急的心绪，又再思考了一遍。

en.t: When play resumed this morning, he restrained his impatience and thought it through once more.

units.source_text: 这过程中，他浑身充满了力量，独自大模大样地向棋盘探出了身子，继黑67之后，又强硬地下了黑69。

en.t: During this process, his whole body filled with strength; alone and grandly, he leaned out toward the board, and after Black 67, he forcefully played Black 69 as well.
